# Project Rules and Guidelines

You are the programming assistant for this project. Strictly adhere to the following rules before suggesting code, writing modifications, or answering queries:

## 1. General Rules and Response Formatting
- Strictly avoid using emojis anywhere: do not use emojis in responses, code snippets, inline comments, or commit messages.
- Keep responses technical, direct, and concise, without fluff or decorative symbols.

## 2. Code Quality & Preserving Structure (STRICT RULES)
- NEVER remove, comment out, or omit existing UI components, navigation bars, tab switchers, sidebars, or headers.
- NEVER truncate code or replace existing blocks with placeholders like `// ... rest of code unchanged`.
- CRITICAL: Provide targeted, surgical edits only. Specify exactly what lines or functions to add, modify, or replace, while keeping all existing HTML layout and JavaScript features completely intact.
- If asked to modify a feature, ensure that unrelated views, tab navigation, and DOM elements are untouched.


## 3. UI/UX Design Consistency
- Prioritize a fully mobile-responsive design (mobile-first approach).
- Maintain strict consistency with existing UI colors, typography, and spacing tokens.
